title: Hamisi's lucky day
author: Adelheid Marie Bwire
pages:
Hamisi needs a new
school uniform. His dad
takes him to the
market.

Hamisi sees a boy
wearing a beautiful
shirt. "That is a very
fine shirt," thinks
Hamisi.

"I wish I had a shirt like
that boy," says Hamisi.

"Look, she is selling
those special shirts,"
says Hamisi. "Dad,
please buy one for me,"
he asks.

"Hamisi, I have to buy
your uniform," says
dad.

"I do not have enough
money for that shirt,"
says dad.

Hamisi's dad pays for
the uniform. He is
surprised when he gets
the change. There is
enough money left over
to buy a shirt!

It is Hamisi's lucky day!
Which shirt will he
choose?
